title: Apply for an individual Tax File Number
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for an individual Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Tax Office (ATO).
intro:
You can apply for an individual Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Tax Office (ATO). It’s not compulsory to hold a TFN, but it will help you to:

To complete your application, you may need to:

If you’re operating a business as a sole trader or individual, you can use your individual TFN. For other types of business structures, you’ll need to Apply for a business Tax File Number.

Visit the Australian Tax Office website to learn more about applying for a TFN as an Australian resident, person living outside Australia, foreign passport holder, permanent migrant, or temporary visa holder.
